Instead, it would concentrate in the brain tissues, causing the victim to experience a progressive deterioration of the thought processes. And the substance is also highly addictive. '''X-1''' was the designation given by [[Myk Bidlor]] and his team to the [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that killed [[Aruk Besadii Aora|Aruk]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. It had been developed by the [[Malkite Poisoners]]. Extremely rare and expensive, it preyed on the tissues of the [[Brain/Legends|brain]], slowing a victim's thinking and making them become slow and sluggish. Victims would become addicted to the substance, over a space of several weeks or months, to such an extent that an abrupt withdrawal of the toxin would kill the addicted being.
